Title: Relates to supportive housing procedures
Summary: Implements procedures and requirements for discharge from permanent supported housing programs.
LawCode: Add Art 2-A Title 3 §§46 - 46-c, Soc Serv L; add §741-a, RPAP L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the social services law and the real property actions and proceedings law, in relation to supportive housing procedures
